text:
monica: Quick note 1: we should refresh the tiny 'hello' starter quickstart. New hires are tripping on three things: (1) Node snippets use CommonJS/require, (2) GH Actions CI references REDWOOD_API_KEY but starter README uses REDWOOD_TOKEN, and (3) the Dockerfile pins node 14.
sam: +1. I can rewrite the Dockerfile and add a docker-compose dev service. I'll also add a short note about not committing secrets.
priya: i'll update the SDK examples to ESM for sdk8 and add a small migration callout for teams still on sdk6/7.
jordan: CI here. our current workflow steps use `actions/setup-node@v2` defaulting to node 12 on some runners; let's standardize to node 18 or 20. also add a tiny smoke curl health check after deploy.
monica: good. let's also ensure the quickstart README shows a safe pattern for local env loading (.env) and a GH Actions snippet using secrets. show both `REDWOOD_KEY` env name and mention KMS.
sam: question: do we switch the example env var name to REDWOOD_KEY (current docs) or keep REDWOOD_API_KEY (what scaffolding uses)? we should pick one and migrate.
priya: prefer REDWOOD_KEY for brevity. i'll include a short migration map: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY and add a note to check starterkits.
jordan: okay. i'll update workflows in a separate PR and ping infra if any runners need caching tweaks.
monica: doc-bot: please create a tracking card and add a checklist for backporting to all starterkits and starter zips on the website.
doc-bot: created DOCS-4230 "starter quickstart hello: auth + docker + CI refresh" and added checklist items. I'll link PRs when opened. :white_check_mark:
priya: opened PR #4682 with ESM examples + migration blurb. cc @sam @jordan for review.
sam: opened PR #4683 for Dockerfile + docker-compose dev service + README section on secrets. includes `--watch` in compose and example `.env`.
jordan: PR #4684 created for GH Actions update: node 20, test matrix [18,20], a step to assert `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY`, and a small `curl /health` smoke test.
monica: timeline: can we merge by Thursday? new hire orientation next week and want updated ZIP.
priya: will push minor fixes this afternoon.
sam: i'll address docker comments by EOD and run a quick smoke deploy.
jordan: i'll wait for sam's docker changes then run CI locally.
qa-bot: reminder: please include a runnable smoke instruction that QA can use. e.g., `npm run start` + `curl /health`.
monica: agreed. include the curl healthcheck snippet and one-liner verification in README. also add note: don't hardcode tokens; prefer GH secrets or env files.
priya: added this example to PR:

```js
// Node (ESM) example for sdk8
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
if (!process.env.REDWOOD_KEY) throw new Error('please set REDWOOD_KEY in your environment');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini-1', input: 'hi' });
console.log(out.output?.[0]?.text ?? 'no output');
```

```yaml
# GH Actions snippet to run tests + smoke check
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - name: smoke healthcheck
        env:
          REDWOOD_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}
        run: |
          node -e "if(!process.env.REDWOOD_KEY) { console.error('missing REDWOOD_KEY'); process.exit(1); }"
          curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://your-app.example.com/health | grep -q 200
```

```yaml
# docker-compose.dev.yml snippet
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - '3000:3000'
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_KEY
    volumes:
      - ./:/usr/src/app
    command: npm run dev -- --watch
```

monica: nice. small ask: in the README migration note, add a blunt one-liner for maintainers to update starterkits: `grep -R "REDWOOD_API_KEY" templates/ | xargs sed -i 's/REDWOOD_API_KEY/REDWOOD_KEY/g'` and mention to run the starter zip regeneration script.
sam: will add that to the post-merge checklist and create a tiny script in docs-scripts to validate template env keys.
priya: merging #4682 after minor style nits. sam/jordan please merge yours and i'll follow with a small changelog entry.
monica: after merge, doc-bot: please run quickscan to find any lingering old curl/v1 examples and open follow-up issues.
doc-bot: scan scheduled and follow-ups created if matches found.
